claims.title: Complex-balanced gaps: multiscale finite-cut zero certificates and complete rank-one positive certificates

quoted_fields.interface: Finite rational complex-balanced mass-action input with supplied positive rational c, native falling-factorial physical-time rates and ACTUAL reachable class Gamma. Negative certificates carry finite reachable anchor/pumping paths, nonnegative pumping vectors, positive integer growth exponents and finite offsets. The positive constructor additionally assumes the rational reaction-jump span has rank<=1; arbitrary species/arity/linkages and disabled boundaries remain allowed.
quoted_fields.failure: The total infinite-class decision/certification algorithm and an exact-model undecidability reduction remain UNRESOLVED. Conditional witness search is not a terminating classifier, and arithmetic-hierarchy upper bounds are not hardness/completeness. A finite truncation cannot certify the required uniform positive lower bound. Full-orthant exponential-character tests are sufficient, not necessary. Source-reported Petri-net semilinearity and cited positive/zero-gap comparisons are imported only at the stated contract; citation handles/search excerpts are not an independent Capital governing-body read. No new scientific verification, code execution, primary-source recovery or novelty claim. The coordinator scoped assessment40–50 is correctness-assumed and nonadditive; full total decision remains open. Its elementary finite/infinite-class argument removes a need to assume the source-reported semilinearity/complexity import. The coordinator subsequently read Haslinger1805.04293v1 Section5: its closed-range/canonical-inverse theorem requires a uniform commutator coercivity bound on the relevant forms. Kernel, reaction-row/species dimensions and actual-class restriction are not supplied by ideal membership or coherent-state tests; no reaction-gap classifier is imported. CONTINUATION: One-species full positive certification is a standard path-method plus explicit cost construction, not a full arbitrary-dimensional gap decision or priority/90-level claim. The same ideal/c/actual class can have opposite gap signs when the quantitative reaction presentation changes. Polynomial-shift closed range is a standard exact reformulation, not a coercivity solver. Character witnesses require positive variance and strict certified inequalities, and completeness is unproved. No numerical fixture/code was rerun or held original recovered. CONTINUATION: Motif completeness, universal certificate-size/discovery bounds, all higher-rank positive coverage, total classification and exact-model undecidability are unproved. The rank-one positive result is complete at its actual restricted scope and extends one-species capital, not the general theorem or an independent audit/priority claim. Fixed-motif rate/c dependence is not universal gap-sign invariance. Root proof and source-author derivation are separately attributed; no scientific code or held-original recovery.
